suppress.notes: Owner: UniAuth maintainers. Spring Framework 6.2.20 is not published (Maven Central 404 on 2026-11-05). UniAuth has no XSLT view resolver or XSLT templates, so XsltView-driven SSRF/RCE is unreachable. Remove this entry after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. The application uses spring-boot-starter-web (servlet Spring MVC); spring-webflux is absent from the runtime classpath and no reactive PartEvent limits are used. Remove this entry after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. No user-supplied SpEL is evaluated: there is no SpelExpressionParser/ExpressionParser usage and Thymeleaf templates are authored statically. The power-operator DoS therefore needs expression input the application never accepts. Remove after upgrading.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. RSocket is not a dependency and no RSocket endpoints exist, so a malformed SETUP frame cannot reach this service. Remove this entry after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. The service runs servlet Spring MVC on embedded Tomcat, not WebFlux on the Jetty 12 reactive adapter, so the WebFlux cookie sameSite serialization defect is not reachable. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. No Server-Sent Events endpoints exist (no SseEmitter or streaming view fragments), so the SSE stream corruption defect has no reachable path. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. The Aalto XML processor is absent and the application is servlet Spring MVC, not WebFlux, so this maxInMemorySize bypass is unreachable. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. Functional WebFlux endpoints deployed next to DispatcherServlet do not exist in this application, so the pre-flight header predicate bypass is unreachable. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. WebFlux WebSocket support is not on the classpath and no WebSocket endpoints are exposed, so header leakage in exception reasons cannot occur. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. No @ModelAttribute command objects, WebDataBinder or InitBinder customization exist, so user-supplied property paths are never bound onto a target object; the data-binding DoS path is absent. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. The SpEL expression compiler is not used with SimpleEvaluationContext on user input, and no SpEL evaluation surfaces exist; the safety-guard bypass is unreachable. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. No functional MVC endpoint uses Server-Sent Events, so the functional-web-framework SSE corruption is unreachable. Remove this entry after adopting a fixed Spring Boot 3.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. Spring Security 6.5.12 is not published (Maven Central 404 on 2026-11-05). WebAuthn is not configured and no WebAuthn registration/authentication endpoints exist, so the distributed session user-verification bypass is unreachable. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Security 6.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. DPoP is not used: the application issues custom RS256 JWTs with persistent token families and does not construct DPoPProofJwtDecoderFactory, so the DPoP replay cache attack is unreachable. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Security 6.5.x patch.

Owner: UniAuth maintainers. spring-security-ldap and the UnboundID test container are not dependencies of this runtime, so the embedded LDAP administrative credential and listener exposure cannot occur. Remove after adopting a fixed Spring Security 6.5.x patch.
